findings.stage: heightfield-to-mesh (CEngineLandscapeMap::GenerateStaticMapEntry @02cca940 and the per-patch mesh Save it drives)
findings.algorithm:
There are TWO distinct patch mesh paths written into a bank chunk, both driven from GenerateStaticMapEntry @02cca940. Heights enter via CEngineMap::PeekLandscapeHeight(x,y) (float per integer grid cell).

A) FOREGROUND / LOCAL-DETAIL patch grid (the §3 header patches forge already classifies):
GenerateStaticMapEntry @02cca940:
  1. BuildLODMap(); BuildPatches() @0179837b. BuildPatches allocates PatchGridWidth*PatchGridHeight (fields param_1+0xC = width, +0x10 = height, in units of 16-cell patches) CEngineLandscapePatch objects (0x48 bytes each) and for each calls Initialise(map, patchX<<4, patchY<<4) then BuildLayerMeshes(). i.e. the map is tiled into 16x16-cell patches; each patch owns a 17x17 vertex grid ((pw+1)*(ph+1), pw=ph=16 -> 289) — this is exactly forge's PatchHeader.valid invariant.
  2. Reserve header table: WriteRepeatedByte(0, width*height*GetFileHeaderSize()) where GetFileHeaderSize @07454 returns 0x24. So a fixed table of width*height 0x24-byte patch-file headers is pre-written (zeroed), then back-patched.
  3. For each patch (row-major, y outer 0..height, x inner 0..width): AlignData(GetBankFileAlignment()); CEngineLandscapePatch::SaveCompressed(stream, texturePalette) @017c2eb9.
     SaveCompressed: if patch bit(param+0x3c)>>4&1==0 -> FileDataSize=0,FilePos=0 (skip). Else: build to a CMemoryDataOutputStream via CEngineLandscapePatch::Save(memstream, palette); scratch = ((len*0x41)>>6)+0x80 bytes; lzo1x_999_compress(memPtr,len -> scratch); record FilePos = stream.GetPosition(); WriteSLONG(uncompLen=mem.GetLength()); WriteSLONG(compLen); WriteData(scratch,compLen); FileDataSize = pos_after - FilePos. => on-disk frame = [uncompLen s32LE][compLen s32LE][lzo1x body]. This is exactly forge's FRAME grammar (getU32 uncomp/comp + lzo1x). NOTE: engine uses lzo1x_999; forge emits lzo1x_1 — both decode with the same stock decoder, so no encoder parity needed.
  4. Second pass: seek back to header_pos (param+0x2c), for each patch SaveHeader(stream) @06350 writing the 0x24-byte CFileHeader struct: WriteData(&struct, 0x24). Struct fields (from SaveHeader, in order at struct+0): uStack_34=FilePos(+0x18), uStack_30=FileDataSize(+0x1c), uStack_2c=(+0x20), uStack_28=(+0x24), uStack_24=(+0x28), uStack_20=(+0x2c), uStack_1c=(+0x30), uStack_18=(+0x34), bStack_14=byte flag((+0x3c)>>4&1). i.e. 8 dwords + 1 byte + pad = 0x24. Assert after: GetPosition()==header_pos + width*height*0x24.
  5. Save texture palette (CEngineTexturePalette::Save), record its offset/len at +0x24/+0x28.
  6. Build background-LOD tree (CLandscapeBackgroundDynamicBuildTemplate + CLandscapeBackgroundTreeNode) and SavePatchesToTemporyStream -> AssignFileBlocks -> SaveRootFileBlockAndChildren, which lays the background-LOD frames + the 0x24-byte quadtree directory forge already parses.

B) The actual per-vertex MESH byte layout — CLandscapeBackgroundPatch::Save @02ce3220 (the background tree-node patch; CEngineLandscapePatch::Save is the analogous foreground writer and shares this exact grammar, both wrapped by the identical SaveCompressed at 017c2eb9 / 02ce30c0). Header then geometry:
  WriteUWORD worldX  (+0x110)
  WriteUWORD worldY  (+0x112)
  WriteUWORD coord0  (+0x10c)
  WriteUWORD coord1  (+0x10e)
  WriteEBOOL isWaterOnly (+0x11a)   -- forge PatchHeader.isWaterOnly
  WriteUBYTE detailMode (+0x118)    -- 1 = full-detail
  if isWaterOnly: skip mesh, jump to edge strips.
  else:
    WriteUWORD indexCount (+0x106)  -- triangle count; IB = indexCount*3 u16
    WriteUWORD vertexCount(+0x104)
    WriteUBYTE texExtX (+0x108)
    WriteUBYTE texExtY (+0x10a)
    WriteEBOOL isDXT  (CPixelFormat::IsCompressed)
    *param3 = pos; CTexture::SaveToDataStream(stream); *param3 = len   -- inline texture block (19-byte hdr + raw DXT/ARGB, NOT a codec)
    -- VERTEX BUFFER: Lock VB (in-mem stride 0x18=24). For v in 0..vertexCount:
         WriteUWORD  *(u16)(vb + v*0x18 + 0x00)   -- packed grid X
         WriteUWORD  *(u16)(vb + v*0x18 + 0x02)   -- packed grid Y
         WriteFloat  *(f32)(vb + v*0x18 + 0x04)   -- HEIGHT (world Z, the authored PeekLandscapeHeight)
         WriteULONG  GetPackedNormalFromTargetVertex(vert)  -- 4-byte packed normal (computed from the vertex; forge must call the same packer)
         WriteUWORD  *(u8)(vb + v*0x18 + 0x16)    -- tex/uv byte (zero-extended to u16)
         WriteUWORD  *(u8)(vb + v*0x18 + 0x15)    -- tex/uv byte
       => on-disk vertex record = 2+2+4+4+2+2 = 16 bytes (0x10). Assert: vertexCount*0x10 == vertex_stream.GetLength() (Engine_Landscape_Background_Patch.cpp:0x5a5).
    -- The 16B/vertex stream is then run through CRangeCompressor::Compress(data, vertexCount, elemStride=0x10, outArray): WriteSLONG(compressedLen); WriteData(compressed). CRangeCompressor has a flags==0 RAW/stored fallback -> can emit uncompressed and still decode.
    -- INDEX BUFFER (only if patch bit +0x119 (shared-IB flag) == 0): Lock IB; CRangeCompressor::Compress(ib, indexCount*3, elemStride=2, outArray); WriteSLONG(len); WriteData(compressed). u16 indices, indexCount*3 of them.
  Then always: 4x CPatchTesselationEdgeStrip::Save(stream)  (the 4 patch edges' LOD stitch strips).
  Then WriteEBOOL hasWater; if set, CEngineWaterBackgroundSubPatch::Save(worldX,worldY,...).

Vertex/index GENERATION (CLandscapeBackgroundPatch::BuildVertexAndIndexBuffers @02ce16c0, mirrors the foreground BuildLayerMeshes): allocates IB size (pw*ph*6)*2 bytes and VB size ((pw+1)*(ph+1))*0x18. If detailMode(+0x118)==1 -> BuildFullDetailPatch(vb,ib,...) producing indexCount = pw*ph*2 triangles over the full (pw+1)x(ph+1) grid (2 tris/cell, standard heightfield triangulation); else BuildLODSubSectionBuffersRectangle(...) + optional CacheOptimizeBuffers for LOD-reduced tessellation using the CEdgeToFanBaseMapper. The per-vertex height comes straight from PeekLandscapeHeight(gx,gy) at each grid corner; grid X/Y are the integer corner coords; the normal is computed from the 4 neighbouring cell edge vectors (see BuildTree @0180c90b which reads PeekLandscapeHeight at (x,y),(x+1,y),(x,y+1),(x+1,y+1), builds C3DVectors and cross/edge magnitudes — the same neighbourhood the normal packer uses).
findings.rawFallbackViable: YES for the two inner mesh encoders, NO for the outer frame. Outer frame MUST be LZO1X-framed ([uncompLen][compLen][lzo1x body]) — but forge already emits this with lzo1x_1 and it decodes byte-exact (proven: 26/26 frames, identity round-trip on Darkwood_Filler_08.lev + retargeted ForgeTest chunk), so no encoder parity with lzo1x_999 is needed. INSIDE the frame body, the VB and IB blocks go through CRangeCompressor, which has a flags==0 RAW/stored fallback: emit each block uncompressed with its WriteSLONG length prefix and the stock Decompress_CRangeCompressor reproduces it — no arithmetic-coder port required. The inline texture is 19-byte header + raw DXT (not a codec). So the ONLY compression forge must actually run is stock lzo1x on the outer frame; every inner structure can be emitted raw/verbatim and still render.

findings.algorithm:
TWO-STREAM, BACKPATCH-HEADER build. Confirmed byte flow from the decomp:

(A) SavePatchesToTemporyStream @02deb570 — recursive tree walk (self, then GetSplitBranch->GetBranch(0), GetBranch(1)). For each LOD band in [node+0xe9 .. node+0xea] (FirstNonSplitBand..LastBand, valid 1..7): build the CLandscapeBackgroundPatch (ctor @543), BuildVertexAndIndexBuffers(1), RenderProceduralTexture, then SaveCompressed(patch) into a TEMP DataOutputStream (Data\Misc\StaticMapPatch.tmp, a CBufferedFileDataOutputStream). It records, per node per band, into the node's CLODLoadInfo array: puVar7[0] = stream.GetPosition() BEFORE save (band data OFFSET, +0x00), *(info+4) = posAfter-posBefore (band data SIZE, +0x04), *(info+0xc) = band index (+0x0c). Bands whose geometry is identical to the previous band are de-duped (lines 549-557: same idxCount/vtxCount/vertexCount -> reuse prior band's saved offset, store *(info+0xc)=last_saved_band). GetLodBandInfo @01851cf4 pins the node struct: info = node + 0x14 + band*0x10, i.e. an array of 8 CLODLoadInfo of 0x10 bytes each at node+0x14 (band 0 unused; bands 1..7 live).

(B) AssignFileBlocks @(seed, callee of GenerateStaticMapEntry) — recurse first (children accumulate into a 9-int CFileBlockAccumilatedSizeResult: [0]=header/base cost seeded 0x7a, [1..8]=per-band byte totals). For each live band it adds *(GetLodBandInfo(band)+4) (the SIZE recorded in A) into slot band+1. When a node's accumulated base size (slot0) or any band slot exceeds CLandscapeSettings+0x44 (threshold), OR forced (param3), the node is inserted into the CFileBlockSaveMap std::set (node becomes its own file-block root) and that accumulator slot is reset to 0 so the parent block doesn't recount it. Result = which subtree cut-points get their own file block.

(C) SaveRootFileBlockAndChildren @0181996c — final on-disk emit into the real DataOutputStream, copying mesh bytes back from the temp stream (CDataInputStream over the tmp): AlignData(GetBankFileAlignment); hdrPos=GetPosition; SaveHeader(node, mode=0)  [writes a PLACEHOLDER header so following data lands at the right base]; dataStart=GetPosition; SaveDataIntoFileBlock(node, saveMap, 0,0, isRoot=0) [copies this node's own band frames from tmp into the block]; dataEnd=GetPosition; SaveChildFileBlocks(node) [recurse into child file-block roots]; end=GetPosition; Seek(dataStart-region), SaveDataIntoFileBlock(node, saveMap, dataStart, dataEnd-dataStart, isRoot=1); Seek(hdrPos); SaveHeader(node, mode=1) [REWRITES the real header now that child offsets/sizes are known — this is the backpatch that fills the directory entries]; Seek(end); *outOffset=dataStart; *outSize=dataEnd-dataStart.

The whole tree block is wrapped by GenerateStaticMapEntry @02cca940 (lines 1103-1124): it AlignData's, runs A into the tmp file, closes it, runs B (AssignFileBlocks(forced=1)), reopens tmp as input, runs C into the bank stream, writes outOffset/outSize into node+0x30/node+0x34 (the two subheader dwords), then backpatches the map subheader block (node+0x24,len 0x14) via Seek(local_110)/write. node+0x24=subheader stream pos, node+0x28=texture-palette size, node+0x2c=foreground-patch-header pos, node+0x30=tree data offset, node+0x34=tree data size.

ON-DISK DIRECTORY ENTRY FORMAT (what SaveHeader mode=1 lays down, as parsed by forge parseQuadDir @stbbake.cpp:125, donor base 0x7fc, stride 0x24): {u32 flags; u32 frameOffset (chunk-absolute byte offset of the wired mesh FRAME = a SaveCompressed [uncompLen][compLen][lzo body] block); u32 frameSpan (=8+compLen, the whole on-disk frame length); f32 aabb[6] = minX,minY,minZ,maxX,maxY,maxZ}. Array runs to an all-zero terminator (donor: 4 live entries + zero sentinel at slot 4). Node bounds come from PeekMinZ/PeekMaxZ (@02deb570 lines 538-542) + the node's X/Y extent at node+0xe0/0xe2/0xe4/0xe6. Tree-node frames reference the mesh frames purely by this (frameOffset, frameSpan) pair — NOT by index — which is why on any re-lay the emitter must rewrite frameOffset/frameSpan to where each frame actually landed.

NOTE ON PROVENANCE: the (offset,size,band,AABB) SEMANTICS and the two-stream backpatch flow are decomp-confirmed here. The exact byte serialization of SaveHeader / SaveDataIntoFileBlock (field order, the leading node-AABB block, the 0x24 stride itself) is NOT present in this seed decomp dump (those callees were not included) — the 0x24-entry layout is forge's empirically reversed + read-side-validated form (parseQuadDir, 4/4 wired on the donor), and BAKE_FORGETEST_TERRAIN.md flags the full tree-node HDR grammar as the one remaining bake-and-diff item.

forge::stbbake ALREADY has the READ + REWIRE half of this stage and it is proven (docs: ForgeTest quadtree 4/4 wired):
- parseQuadDir(chunk, dirBase=0x7fc) (stbbake.cpp:125) parses the 0x24-byte entries to the zero terminator -> exactly the directory this decomp builds.
- QuadEntry struct (stbbake.hpp:111) = {dirOffset, flags, frameOffset, frameSpan, aabb[6]} matches the on-disk entry.
- emitChunk (stbbake.cpp:215) already REWIRES every live entry's frameOffset(+4)/frameSpan(+8) via putU32le when a frame moves (lookupMove/lookupNewStart, lines 295-327), and refuses ok when a moved frame is untracked.
- retargetChunk (stbbake.cpp:150) verifies each entry wires to a real frame and its AABB min<=max.

WHAT FORGE STILL MUST ADD to OWN generation (not just rewire a donor's directory):
1. BUILD the tree, not just re-lay it. There is no native quadtree builder. Port the node model: node struct with CLODLoadInfo[8] at node+0x14 (0x10 stride: +0 off, +4 size, +0xc band), split branches, node XY extent (+0xe0..+0xe6), band range (+0xe9 FirstNonSplitBand..+0xea LastBand), Z bounds via Peek/computed from authored heights. Mirror SavePatchesToTemporyStream's recursion (self, branch0, branch1) and its band de-dup rule (identical idx/vtx/vertex count => reuse prior band's offset).
2. Compute node AABBs from authored heights: minZ/maxZ = min/max sampled height over the node's XY footprint; minX/minY/maxX/maxY from the node cell in world coords (ForgeTest 2784..2816). Write them into aabb[6] in donor order (minX,minY,minZ,maxX,maxY,maxZ).
3. Lay frames + build directory in one pass: for each background-LOD frame emitted (forge already emits standard-LZO1X framed blocks via forge::lzo::compressFramed), record its chunk-absolute start as frameOffset and 8+compLen as frameSpan into a fresh QuadEntry; write a zero terminator after the last. This is a small addition next to emitChunk — emitChunk already knows every frame's newStart/newSpan (startMap/frameMoves), so a generateQuadDir(frames, aabbs) can synthesize the entry array instead of only patching an existing one.
4. AABB ordering must match the renderer's cull (read side already accepts minX,minY,minZ,maxX,maxY,maxZ per parseQuadDir/retargetChunk aabbOk check, lines 172-177). Keep that order.
5. AssignFileBlocks thresholding (settings+0x44) only decides child-block CUT points; for a single small custom region ForgeTest bakes as ONE root block (donor has 4 quad entries, no child file blocks), so a first native impl can force a single root block (param3=1 path) and skip the multi-block split — matches AssignFileBlocks(forced=1) at GenerateStaticMapEntry:1117.
6. Do NOT try to port SaveHeader byte-exact from this decomp — it is not in the dump. Pin its exact field layout by bake-and-diff (author two 1-cell-different heightfields, diff chunks) per BAKE_FORGETEST_TERRAIN.md before trusting a from-scratch header emit; until then, mutate a donor's tree-node HDR (which forge already round-trips byte-exact) and only regenerate the 0x24 entries + AABBs.
Cross-ref caller: node+0x30/+0x34 (tree data offset/size) and node+0x24/0x28/0x2c subheader dwords are backpatched by GenerateStaticMapEntry@02cca940:1122-1138 — these are the 5 position dwords NATIVE_STB_WRITER_SCOPE.md §3 already models (+0x20/+0x24/+0x58/+0x5C/+0x71); the tree-data pair (+0x30/+0x34 within the InfoBlock/subheader) must be rebased alongside them.
findings.rawFallbackViable: YES for the frames the directory points at; N/A for the directory itself. The quad-dir entries wire to mesh FRAMEs that are standard-LZO1X framed blocks (SaveCompressed -> [uncompLen][compLen][lzo body]); forge emits these with lzo1x_1 (worse ratio than the editor's lzo1x_999 but the retail loader decodes both identically — proven byte-exact round-trip on donor + ForgeTest chunks). The VB/IB inside a frame body use CRangeCompressor which has a flags==0 RAW/stored fallback, and CTexture::SaveToDataStream is a 19-byte header + raw DXT (no codec) — so NO encoder parity is needed to render. The 0x24-byte directory entries and node AABBs are themselves RAW little-endian u32/f32 structs (not compressed at all): forge just writes them. So the whole stage is emittable as raw/uncompressed-friendly data with only the existing lzo1x framing on the mesh bodies — no new encoder. The ONLY non-raw dependency is knowing SaveHeader's exact field order (open, per BAKE doc), not any codec.

findings.algorithm:
Two distinct write sites, both proven from decomp. NEITHER uses a codec and NEITHER emits a texture-NAME string — textures are DXT bytes baked inline, keyed only by position, and themes resolve globally.

=== A. PER-PATCH INLINE TEXTURE (inside each mesh FRAME body) ===
Written by CLandscapeBackgroundPatch::Save @0x02ce3220 (decomp: landscape_savecomp_decomp.log L139-159), which is serialized into a CMemoryDataOutputStream and then LZO1x-999 framed by SaveCompressed @0x02ce30c0 (L84-85: WriteSLONG(uncompLen), WriteSLONG(compLen), body). The §3 header + texture write order, byte-exact, all little-endian:
  WriteUWORD  pw           (obj+0x110)                     ; 2B
  WriteUWORD  ph           (obj+0x112)                     ; 2B
  WriteUWORD  coord0       (obj+0x10c)                     ; 2B
  WriteUWORD  coord1       (obj+0x10e)                     ; 2B
  WriteEBOOL  IsWaterOnly  (obj+0x11a)                     ; 1B  (if !=0 -> skip mesh+texture entirely, jump to edge strips)
  WriteUBYTE  DetailMode   (obj+0x118)                     ; 1B
  --- if IsWaterOnly==0: ---
  WriteUWORD  IndexCount   (obj+0x106)                     ; 2B
  WriteUWORD  VertexCount  (obj+0x104)                     ; 2B
  WriteUBYTE  texExtX      (obj+0x108)                     ; 1B  (C2DExtentsI width arg)
  WriteUBYTE  texExtY      (obj+0x10a)                     ; 1B
  GetPixelFormat(); uVar3 = IsCompressed(pixelfmt);
  WriteEBOOL  isDXT (=IsCompressed)                        ; 1B  (true => D3DFMT_DXT1 0x31545844; false => GetBestAlphaTextureFormat)
  *param_3 = stream.GetPosition()                          ; record texture-blob start offset
  CTexture::SaveToDataStream(stream) @ (thunk 017f0436)    ; == 19-byte header + raw DXT payload (NOT a codec)
  *param_3 = stream.GetPosition() - *param_3               ; record texture-blob byte length
Then VB (Lock; per-vertex u16 x,u16 y,f32 z,u32 packedNormal,u16,u16; packed to 16B/vtx; Compress_CRangeCompressor(...,VertexCount,0x10); WriteSLONG(len)+bytes), then IB if obj+0x119==0 (Compress_CRangeCompressor(ib,IndexCount*3,2); WriteSLONG+bytes), then 4x CPatchTesselationEdgeStrip::Save + WaterSubPatch EBOOL. The whole body is LZO-framed.
The 19-byte CTexture::SaveToDataStream header itself is NOT in the write-side decomp bodies (SaveToDataStream is only a thunk here) — its field breakdown is the CGraphicHeader/CPixelFormatInit family documented elsewhere (BIG uses a 34B variant; the inline STB variant is 19B). Loader mirror LoadFromDataStreamToPreallocatedSurface @ (L481) reads this blob back into the preallocated surface, so a raw DXT block that decodes to the declared C2DExtentsI(texExtX,texExtY) at DXT1 is sufficient. No name string is written anywhere in the frame (stbvalidate T0 confirms: zero NUL-terminated texture names in retail chunks).

=== B. THE TEXTURE PALETTE (per-map, in the InfoBlock/landscape sub-stream) ===
Written by CEngineLandscapeMap::GenerateStaticMapEntry @0x02cca940 (decomp lines 934,942,1037):
  Reset_CEngineTexturePalette(param_6)                    ; twice, clears the palette accumulator
  ... SaveCompressed_CEngineLandscapePatch(param_3, param_1+0x40) per patch (each Save registers its inline texture into the palette param_6) ...
  *(param_1+0x24) = param_2.GetPosition()                 ; record palette start (this becomes LandscapeMapPtr region)
  Save_CEngineTexturePalette(param_2)                     ; writes the whole palette blob
  *(param_1+0x28) = param_2.GetPosition() - *(param_1+0x24)  ; record palette byte length
The local-detail side mirrors this: CLocalDetailCacheMap::GenerateStaticMapEntry @0x02e3bf00 (L1239) writes Save_CObjectTypeCollectionPalette(param_2,param_4) after a 0xC-byte (3xu32) sub-header. Per CHUNK_LAYOUT_SPEC §1.3: at LandscapeMapPtr the sub-stream is a 0x14-byte (5xu32) header then CEngineTexturePalette; at LocalDetailMapPtr a 0xC-byte header then CQuadTreeElement::LoadHeader + CObjectTypeCollectionPalette. Save_CEngineTexturePalette / Save_CObjectTypeCollectionPalette bodies are NOT decompiled (thunks only) — their internal grammar is OPAQUE-BUT-PRESERVED (chunk_parse.py records them as HDR segments).

=== KEYING / READ-PATH RESOLUTION ===
Keying is purely POSITIONAL, not by name/index: CStaticMapInfoBlock (0x5C) carries LandscapeMapPtr(+abs offset) and LocalDetailMapPtr(+abs offset); the loader OpenDevelopmentStaticMap SetPosition(stream,LandscapeMapPtr)->CEngineLandscapeMap::OpenStaticMap->CEngineTexturePalette::Load. In retail, the same (offset,size) is a CEngineStaticMapFileBlockManager block key (AddRequest/GetBlockData). The InfoBlock has NO theme field. BuildThemes @0x00b687d0 resolves against the global install-wide ENGINE_THEME table (name-agnostic, identical for every map) — nothing per-map to register (TERRAIN_WHITEOUT_FIX.md, HIGH confidence). So the read path resolves inline textures by seeking to the palette offset in the chunk, and themes globally.
findings.portNotes:
forge treats the entire inline texture + palette as opaque bytes today: (1) per-patch DXT lives inside an LZO FRAME body that stbbake only round-trips via RawPassthrough (never re-serializes the §3 texture fields), and (2) the CEngineTexturePalette / CObjectTypeCollectionPalette blobs at LandscapeMapPtr/LocalDetailMapPtr are preserved verbatim as HDR segments. stb.cpp has zero palette/texture/theme code. To OWN an authored-heights bake, forge must add to stbbake:

1. A per-patch Save-body writer that emits the §3 header exactly as landscape_savecomp_decomp.log L139-152: [u16 pw][u16 ph][u16 coord0][u16 coord1][EBOOL isWaterOnly][u8 detailMode] then (if !water) [u16 indexCount][u16 vertexCount][u8 texExtX][u8 texExtY][EBOOL isDXT] followed by the inline texture blob, then CRangeCompressor VB (RAW flags==0), IB, edge strips. parsePatchHeader (stbbake.hpp) already parses 15 of these bytes on the READ side — invert it. The isDXT EBOOL must be written from the chosen format (emit DXT1 => isDXT=1).

2. A CTexture::SaveToDataStream emitter: 19-byte header + raw DXT1 payload sized (texExtX,texExtY) at 8B per 4x4 block. RAW-viable — no encoder parity needed; any valid DXT1 block that decodes to the declared extents renders (loader = LoadFromDataStreamToPreallocatedSurface). findings.stage: infoblock-offsets — CStaticMapInfoBlock (0x5C) write layout from CEngineMap::WriteMapInfoBlock @02d67ea0
findings.algorithm:
WriteMapInfoBlock @02d67ea0 (static: ?WriteMapInfoBlock@CEngineMap@@CIX...) takes param_1 = &CStaticMapInfoBlock (a 0x5C struct, addressed as dword array param_1[i], byte off = i*4) and param_2 = &CDataOutputStream. It emits the 0x5C record as a FIXED PERMUTATION of the struct's memory order — NOT struct order. Exact write sequence (little-endian; SLONG=WriteSLONG, ULONG=WriteULONG, box=stream vtbl+0x10 Write(ptr,len)):

 1  WriteSLONG param_1[0]    -> struct+0x00  VersionID
 2  WriteSLONG param_1[1]    -> struct+0x04  BankFileIndex
 3  WriteSLONG param_1[3]    -> struct+0x0c  EdgeHeightFileSize
 4  WriteSLONG param_1[8]    -> struct+0x20  MapWidth
 5  WriteSLONG param_1[9]    -> struct+0x24  MapHeight
 6  WriteSLONG param_1[10]   -> struct+0x28  WorldX
 7  WriteSLONG param_1[0xb]  -> struct+0x2c  WorldY
 8  WriteSLONG param_1[2]    -> struct+0x08  EdgeHeightFilePtr
 9  WriteSLONG param_1[4]    -> struct+0x10  LandscapeMapPtr
10  WriteSLONG param_1[5]    -> struct+0x14  LocalDetailMapPtr
11  WriteSLONG param_1[0xc]  -> struct+0x30  Quality
12  WriteSLONG param_1[0xd]  -> struct+0x34  ShorePointArraySize
13  WriteSLONG param_1[0xe]  -> struct+0x38  ShorePointArrayStart
14  WriteULONG param_1[0xf]  -> struct+0x3c  LevelChecksum  (only ULONG; all others SLONG)
15  WriteSLONG param_1[6]    -> struct+0x18  ChecksumBlockFilePtr
16  WriteSLONG param_1[7]    -> struct+0x1c  ChecksumBlockFileSize
17  Write(param_1+0x10, 0x18) -> struct+0x40 CameraMapBounds  (C3DBoundingBox = 6 float: minx,miny,minz,maxx,maxy,maxz, raw 24 bytes via stream vtbl slot +0x10)
18  WriteSLONG param_1[0x16] -> struct+0x58  HeaderEndPtr

On-disk record length = 18 dwords*4 with the box counting as 6 = 17 scalar writes*4 + one 0x18 box = 0x5C (92) bytes, exactly. This is a byte-for-byte inverse of ReadMapInfoBlock @02d5c230 (mapinfo_decomp.log:47-94; identical index permutation with Read* instead of Write*), so the disk field ORDER above is authoritative.

WHERE IT LANDS / OFFSET COMPUTATION: WriteMapInfoBlock itself does NO offset math and NO page alignment — it just appends 0x5C bytes at the stream's current position. It is invoked once per map while building the __STATIC_MAP_COMMON_HEADER__ STB entry (reached by a name->reloff index; the 0x5C record sits at COMMON_HEADER+reloff). The 5 absolute-offset dwords the task asks about are FIELDS INSIDE this record that other code fills BEFORE WriteMapInfoBlock serializes them; they are absolute byte offsets into the per-map bank-file chunk (the __ENGINE_SEA_STATIC_MAP_BANK_FILE__ payload), computed in GenerateStaticMapEntry @02cca940 as stream.GetPosition() snapshots:
  - struct+0x10 LandscapeMapPtr  set at line 1036: *(param_1+0x24)=GetPosition() just before Save (this is the '+0x24' family in the struct-mem view; note struct+0x24 in GenerateStaticMapEntry's OWN object is a different this-ptr than the InfoBlock struct — do not conflate).
  Per NATIVE_TERRAIN_STATUS.md §3 the verified chunk-relative invariants (398/398 maps) are: InfoBlock/subheader +0x20 -> landscape subheader (== chunk+0x5C), +0x24 -> localdetail subheader (== chunk+0x71), +0x58 -> chunk-end, +0x5C -> landscape dword0 (== chunk+0x70), +0x71 -> detail dword0. These are captured as GetPosition() deltas relative to the chunk base as GenerateStaticMapEntry writes each sub-body, then stored into the InfoBlock dwords that WriteMapInfoBlock later serializes.

PAGE ALIGNMENT (separate mechanism, NOT in WriteMapInfoBlock): frame/body placement inside the bank chunk is page-aligned by CDataOutputStream::AlignData @ (?AlignData@CDataOutputStream@@QAEXJ@Z), called in GenerateStaticMapEntry at lines 936 and 984 with the alignment from CEngineWorldMap::GetBankFileAlignment. AlignData formula (decomp lines 6613-6624): pos = stream.GetPosition(); if ((align-1) & pos) != 0 then WriteRepeatedByte(0, ((pos-1)+align & ~(align-1)) - pos). i.e. classic round-up-to-power-of-2: padCount = alignUp(pos,align)-pos, emitting zero PAD bytes. align is a power of two (donor evidence: 0x1000 page starts). This pad math is what produces the 0x1000-aligned frame starts (4096/12288/20480/... with zero PAD gaps) that emitChunk must reproduce.

findings.stage: compression-framing (per-block codec selection + LZO frame framing)
findings.algorithm:
TWO NESTED COMPRESSION LAYERS. The editor bake writes each baked mesh as an OUTER LZO1X frame whose body is an INNER Save stream; inside that Save stream the VB/IB are CRangeCompressor sub-blocks. Byte-level write algorithm:

=== OUTER FRAME (CLandscapeBackgroundPatch::SaveCompressed @02ce30c0; identical twin CEngineLandscapePatch::SaveCompressed @017c2eb9/decomp line 6789) ===
1. Save(...) serializes the patch into a CMemoryDataOutputStream -> the uncompressed body. iVar1 = GetLength() of that stream = uncompLen (decomp line 3028).
2. worstCase = ((uncompLen * 0x41) >> 6) + 0x80 (line 3029; == LZO1X worst-case + slack). Alloc dst CArray[worstCase] + workmem CArray[0x70000] (== LZO1X_999_MEM_COMPRESS).
3. lzo1x_999_compress(bodyPtr, uncompLen, dst, &dstLen, workmem) (line 3038). dstLen = actual compressed length.
4. WriteSLONG(dstLen)  -> compLen  (line 3040)
   WriteSLONG(uncompLen) -> uncompLen (line 3041; the ((*0x41)>>6)+0x80 slot, reused)
   WriteRawData(dst, ...) -> compLen bytes of lzo1x body (line 3043, vtbl+0x10 = WriteData).

CRITICAL — on-disk field ORDER is [uncompLen u32LE][compLen u32LE][lzo1x body], NOT the WriteSLONG call order. Authoritative proof = the retail LOADER LoadCompressed @02cdf170: local_14 = ReadSLONG() FIRST and is used as the decompress DST alloc size (local_14+3) and the output_size==uncompressed_size assert (if local_50==local_14) -> FIRST field = uncompLen; local_4c = ReadSLONG() SECOND is passed as the compressed source length to the decompressor -> SECOND field = compLen. WriteSLONG is __fastcall reading the arg off the stack, and Ghidra aliases the reused stack slot, which is why the two writes read swapped in the decomp text — the loader read order is the ground truth and it is [uncompLen][compLen][body]. All 18 donor frames decode with stock lzo1x_decompress_safe to EXACTLY the declared uncompLen, rc LZO_E_OK.

=== INNER CRangeCompressor sub-blocks (inside Save @02ce3220, they land in the LZO body) ===
Per landscape_savecomp_decomp.log lines 222-238:
- VB:  compLenV = Compress_CRangeCompressor(vertexData, vertexCount@+0x104, mode, scratch); WriteSLONG(compLenV); WriteRawData(compressedVB).
- IB (only if waterOnly byte @+0x119 == 0): compLenI = Compress_CRangeCompressor(indexData, indexCount@+0x106 * 3, mode=2, scratch); WriteSLONG(compLenI); WriteRawData(compressedIB); Unlock.
Each inner block on the Save stream is framed [u32 rangeCompLen][rangeCompressor body]. CRangeCompressor is a self-describing bit-packer; its flags==0 form is a RAW/stored passthrough that Decompress_CRangeCompressor @ (lines 503/553) copies verbatim, so a forge-emitted uncompressed block still decodes.

=== CODEC-PER-BLOCK VERDICT ===
- Every SaveCompressed FRAME body: stock LZO1X (write=lzo1x_999, decode=stock lzo1x_decompress). No CRangeCompressor at the outer frame layer — grep of the outer bake path shows lzo1x_999_compress is the ONLY compressor called.
- VB & IB sub-blocks inside the frame body: CRangeCompressor (with flags==0 RAW fallback available).
- Texture/DXT, index arrays, quadtree dir, headers: RAW (uncompressed) — CTexture::SaveToDataStream = 19-byte header + raw DXT, not a codec.
- Inter-frame gaps: HDR (raw structured) or zero PAD to block-manager page boundary.

Do NOT swap the [uncompLen][compLen] order — it is fixed by the loader, and any deviation trips the output_size==uncompressed_size assert (LoadCompressed @02cdf170 line 335) or crashes the DST alloc.

findings.algorithm:
The local-detail half is the SCENERY/FOREGROUND-OBJECT cache (a CQuadTreeElement quadtree of CObjectCacheGroupCollections + an object-type palette), NOT a second landscape mesh. It is written to the DEV DataOutputStream (param_2/param_3) by GenerateStaticMapEntry @02e3bf00 in this exact byte order:

1) @02e3bf60-90: Clear@CQuadTreeElement(0) resets the root, then a nested loop (rows = PeekHeight()>>4, cols = PeekWidth()>>4; PeekWidth/Height read CEngineMap+0x70/+0x72) calls UpdateDynamicArea@CQuadTreeElement(map=this+8, col<<4, row<<4, 0x10,0x10, false, primArray) once per 16x16 cell. This GATHERS live scenery primitives from the map into the quadtree. For an authored region with NO placed scenery, every cell gathers nothing -> the root has an empty group list and no children.

2) Clear@CObjectTypeCollectionPalette empties the palette (a std::vector<CLocalDetailObjectCollectionType*>).

3) local_2c = stream->GetPosition() (vtbl+8). WriteRepeatedByte(0, 0xC) @6315 writes a 12-BYTE ZERO PLACEHOLDER (three u32s, back-patched in step 8).

4) CFileBlockSaveMap ctor (a std::set<void*> of nodes chosen to become file blocks).

5) AssignFileBlocks@CQuadTreeElement(saveMap, forceRoot=1, palette=this+0x6c) @7824: recurses the group linked-list (node+4 chain) and 4 children (node+8..+0x14). For each object-cache group it calls GetSaveSize@CObjectCacheGroupCollection; if size > CEngineLocalDetailGenerator::PeekMinimumFileBlockSize it AddBlock()s that node, else accumulates. Adds 0x40 per node; forces the ROOT into a block because forceRoot=1. Empty tree -> exactly one block: the root.

6) SaveTree@CQuadTreeElement(param_3, saveMap, palette) @8653: AlignData(GetBankFileAlignment) aligns the stream, records file_block_start, SaveFileBlock(...,0,0,false) writes the root block, SaveSubFileBlocks recurses children, then rewrites the root SaveFileBlock(start, end-start, true) now that the size is known. (SaveFileBlock/GetSaveSize/CLocalDetailObjectCollectionType::Save are NOT in this decomp dump — the leaf object-record byte grammar is unresolved, but is only reached when scenery EXISTS.)

7) local_38 = GetPosition(); SaveHeader@CQuadTreeElement(param_2, header=1) @8474 writes a FIXED 0x2C (44)-byte CFileHeader: 4x u16 from node+0x40/+0x42/+0x44/+0x46, then u32s FileBlockPos(node+0x34), FileBlockSize(node+0x38), OffsetIntoFileBlock(node+0x3c), node+0x2c, node+0x30, node+0x18, node+0x1c, node+0x20, node+0x24 — emitted as one 0x2C write (vtbl+0x10, &uStack_3c, 0x2c). Assert: FileBlockPos>0 && FileBlockSize>0 && 0<=OffsetIntoFileBlock<FileBlockSize.

8) Save@CObjectTypeCollectionPalette(param_2, param_4) @7955: WriteEBOOL(param_4) [1 byte] + WriteSLONG(count) [4 bytes] + per-entry CLocalDetailObjectCollectionType::Save. EMPTY palette = exactly 5 bytes: {bool, u32 0}.

9) local_34 = GetPosition()-local_38 (size of header+palette region). local_14 = GetPosition(). Back-patch: Seek(local_2c); Write(&local_38, 0xC) — writes the 12-byte prefix = { u32 local_38 (offset where SaveHeader began), u32 local_34 (header+palette byte length), u32 local_14 (end offset) }; then Seek(local_14) to restore the tail. Clear@CQuadTreeElement(0); ~CFileBlockSaveMap.

The tree still emits one aligned root block (forceRoot=1), so it is NOT zero-length, but it contains zero object records.
